messages:
maria: quick question — behavior for GET /v2/jobs/{id} polling when client concurrently calls DELETE to cancel? do we return the final result if already finished, or an immediate cancelled state? need to lock down for SDKs/docs. cc @sam @drew

sam: my take: DELETE should be best-effort. if job hasn't hit terminal, DELETE -> 202 + body {"action": "cancellation_queued"} and status becomes "cancelling". if job already terminal, DELETE -> 200 + body {status: "success"} (or the terminal status). avoid 409 unless it's a hard conflict.

drew: +1 but we should be explicit about the polling contract: pollers should treat any terminal status as final, even if they got a 202 earlier. suggest this schema:
```
{
  "id": "...",
  "status": "queued|running|cancelling|cancelled|success|failed",
  "attempts": 1,
  "result": null,
  "updated_at": "2024-05-01T12:34:56Z"
}
```
Also recommend header `X-Job-Terminal: true|false` on poll responses to help fragile clients.

anna: concern: v1 clients expect only `queued|running|success|failed`. adding `cancelling` might break strict enums in some SDKs. proposal: keep `status` values backward compatible by mapping `cancelling` -> `running` for v1, and add `status_detail` freeform string for extended states.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421 — adds cancel flow docs and examples

infra-bot: deploy finished: canary to staging @ 1715130200 :rocket:

maria: thanks all. action items: sam to add HTTP semantics + sample responses to API spec, anna to add compatibility mapping and unit tests, drew to add header and poller guidance to SDKs. can we aim for patch by EOD tomorrow? :calendar:

sam: noted, will draft spec snippet. ping me if you want a quick review.

drew: i'll add tests to js/python sdks. quick question — should DELETE be idempotent? i assume yes: repeated DELETEs should return same 202 or 200 once terminal.

sam: yes idempotent. repeated DELETEs on an already-cancelled job -> 200 with status cancelled.

maria: great, thanks. if anyone sees edge-cases (e.g., long-running jobs that finish during window) post here. I'll merge docs PR once PR reviews land. :thumbsup:
